prompt: As of July 1, 2024, what is the parent company of the current record label of the singer of Edge of Seventeen?
answer: As of July 1, 2024, the singer of **“Edge of Seventeen,” Stevie Nicks, was associated with Atlantic Records**, whose parent company is **Warner Music Group (WMG)**.
